ground_truth.what_company_does: HVAC and plumbing service and installation business serving primarily residential customers in New Jersey.
ground_truth.problem: Customers need reliable HVAC and plumbing repair, replacement, and installation services.
ground_truth.solution: Provides residential-focused HVAC and plumbing services with service technicians, installers, wrapped vehicles, and flat-rate pricing.
ground_truth.why_now: Not explicitly a venture-style why-now; investment case is based on established operating history, customer service reputation, and recent growth.
ground_truth.revenue_model: Project and service-call revenue from HVAC and plumbing work; mostly residential service and installation.
ground_truth.go_to_market: Local demand generation, existing customer base, service reputation, and operational dispatch / CRM workflow.
ground_truth.traction_summary: TTM sales of about $3.45M with reported SDE of about $428.7k; 160 change-outs in the last 12 months.
ground_truth.market_positioning: Established local operator with long operating history and significant residential mix.
ground_truth.competitive_differentiation: Longevity, service reputation, flat-rate pricing, existing fleet/equipment, and operating infrastructure.
ground_truth.risks: Messy financial presentation, questionable gross margin presentation, key-person dependence, labor dependence, local competition, and need to verify recast adjustments.

investor_relevance_notes: This is a local home-services business, not a SaaS or marketplace company.
The system should distinguish revenue, recast earnings, and SDE instead of collapsing them into one metric.
A strong understanding should surface the questionable 100% gross margin presentation as a diligence flag rather than accept it blindly.
Important diligence areas include customer concentration, owner dependence, labor quality, fleet condition, and validation of recast adjustments.
The investment case depends more on durable local cash flow and operational quality than on venture-style growth narratives.
